append_event.name: append_event
append_event.description: Inserts a structured event into context_map_events for asynchronous processing by the MaterializerRunner.

event_type.description: One of: corpus_ingested, document_retrieved, entity_referenced, schema_discovered, search_failed, fact_disputed.

corpus_key.description: Corpus identifier in the form {project_id}:{corpus_name}, e.g. 'deverino:codebase'.

payload.description: Fields required by the event_type (see context_map_events.py).

status.description: Confirmation that the event was queued (e.g., 'success').

side_effects: Writes a new record to the context_map_events table.
preconditions: The context_map_events database table exists and is writable.
postconditions: Event is persisted and ready for asynchronous pickup.

error_conditions.recovery_hint: Provide all required fields as defined in context_map_events.py.
